Noah: Heads-up: support flagged a customer who changed a feature flag in console but traffic kept flowing to old bucket. Quick triage suggests the console writes a pending override but our rollout merges drop it because of a schema mismatch on field scope.
Rina: Oof. Which field?
Noah: `quota_assignment` has historically been a string but we introduced typed objects for per-region quotas. Console still posts plain-string overrides during edit, merge layer rejects without clear error.
Carlos: We added server-side validation but we didn't surface validation failures back to the console UX. So console assumes success and shows the toggle active.
Mei: Can we short-term accept both shapes? Add a compatibility shim in merge that accepts string and converts to `{ default: "<val>" }` during eval.
Rina: That avoids immediate customer impact. But we should also fix the root cause: console should surface validation errors inline and block the apply if schema mismatches.
Noah: Agreed. Proposed triage: 1) compatibility shim in merge layer (low-risk). 2) console: validate before apply and show inline error with link to migration guide. 3) telemetry: emit `config.apply.validation_failure` and `config.ui_shows_applied_but_rejected` when mismatch occurs.
Carlos: Telemetry tags: field, org_id, project_id, schema_version, sdk_version. Also include `applied_payload_sha` so we can dedupe.
Mei: Add a dashboard widget: "UI vs Runtime config mismatches" with top offending fields and rate per-org. Alert if any org > 20 mismatches/day.
Rina: We should also backfill historical events. Can audits-bot scan the last 7 days for `apply` requests that had HTTP 202 (accepted) but later reconciled to previous value? That would help estimate scope.
audits-bot: audit-scan started for last 7 days at 2024-06-03T10:02:00Z  scan id as-3341
Noah: Nice. For the compatibility shim, ensure it's opt-out via a runtime flag `compat.accept_string_quota_assignment=false` so we can flip it off after migration.
Carlos: Also we need a warning banner in console for orgs using older SDKs: "You're using an older SDK; some config shapes are deprecated and may be incompatible. Update SDK to v2.3+". We can derive SDK version from the `client_agent` field on apply requests.
Mei: For rollout: 1) deploy shim to staging, run audit-scan results to pick top 10 orgs, enable shim for them for 48h. 2) simultaneously ship console validation and banner. 3) After 2 weeks, disable shim by default and only keep it for 1% orgs for safety.
Rina: Add a migration doc and a small CLI snippet to convert existing string quotas to the new object form. Put in docs repo and link from console banner.
Noah: Edge case: what if a customer intentionally used string form and expects old semantics? We should add an audit tag `compat_shim_applied` to the config history so admins can see when we transformed their override.
Carlos: Good call. Also emit `config.compat_transform` event with before/after snapshot hashes, not the raw values (avoid secret leakage).
Mei: Ops: set up alert rule `ui_runtime_mismatch` when `config.ui_shows_applied_but_rejected` > 50 in 1h across all orgs and >5 for any single org. Include runbook link in alert.
deploybot: deploy: merge shim service deployed to canary at 2024-06-03T10:20:05Z  id shim-dpl-221
Rina: Post-deploy checks: run audit-scan results, test console applies with both shapes, verify telemetry fires.
Noah: I'll own the shim PR and the telemetry events. Carlos will own console validation UX. Mei will own dashboards and runbook. Rina will coordinate rollout.
Mei: Quick UX note: don't show cryptic error codes. Show "Invalid quota format: expected object with default field. Click to auto-convert" and offer a one-click convert that shows the diff preview.
Carlos: That one-click convert should call a server-side `transform_preview` endpoint that returns proposed converted object and an audit token if accepted.
Noah: Ok. Timeline: shim + telemetry today, console validation + transform-preview by early next week, dashboards + alerts within 72 hours.
Rina: Thanks team. Let's close the loop in this thread once audit-scan finishes.
audits-bot: audit-scan completed at 2024-06-03T10:47:12Z  as-3341  found 142 potential mismatches across 18 orgs
Noah: That gives us a decent target list. Scheduling follow-up. :pray:
